    # Pivot position within build zone (x=12.0, y=2.6)
    pivot_x, pivot_y = 12.0, 2.6
    arm_len = 4.0  # Required to reach x=15.0m when horizontal
    arm_height = 0.26
    arm = sandbox.add_beam(
        x=pivot_x,
        y=pivot_y,
        width=arm_height,
        height=arm_len,
        angle=0.0,
        density=28.0,
    )
    sandbox.add_joint(arm, None, (pivot_x, pivot_y), type="pivot")
    
    # Head at the end of the arm (x=16.0m, y=2.6m)
    head_width = 0.7  # Increased width for more mass
    head_height = 0.7  # Increased height for more mass
    head = sandbox.add_beam(
        x=pivot_x + arm_len,
        y=pivot_y,
        width=head_width,
        height=head_height,
        angle=0.0,
        density=80.0,  # Reduced density to stay under mass limit
    )
    sandbox.add_joint(arm, head, (pivot_x + arm_len, pivot_y), type="rigid")
    
    sandbox.set_material_properties(arm, restitution=0.2)
    sandbox.set_material_properties(head, restitution=0.2)
    
    mass = sandbox.get_structure_mass()
    if mass > sandbox.MAX_STRUCTURE_MASS:
        raise ValueError(f"Structure mass {mass:.2f} kg exceeds limit {sandbox.MAX_STRUCTURE_MASS} kg")
    return head

def agent_action(sandbox, agent_body, step_count):

    bar_body = None
    for body in sandbox.bodies:
        if abs(body.position[0] - 15.0) < 0.1:
            bar_body = body
            break
    
    if not bar_body:
        return
